hard_outage_fast_fail.description: Primary answers 503 in 50 ms for 3 min.

hard_outage_timeout.description: Primary hangs past the 2 s timeout for 3 min (no safe retry).

technical_brownout.description: 40% of the primary's requests fail with a fast 503 for 3 min.

approval_gray_failure.description: Primary processes everything but approves only 60% for 3 min.

gradual_approval_degrade.description: Primary approval falls linearly 95% -> 60% over 2 min, holds 1 min, then recovers.

flapping.description: Primary alternates 15 s down (503) / 45 s up from minute 2 to minute 8.

weak_secondary.description: Secondary approves 88%; primary 503 for 3 min, so failback speed matters.

steady_gap_0_5pp_right_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 0.5 pp; priority lists the better acquirer first.

steady_gap_0_5pp_wrong_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 0.5 pp; priority lists the worse acquirer first.

steady_gap_1pp_right_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 1 pp; priority lists the better acquirer first.

steady_gap_1pp_wrong_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 1 pp; priority lists the worse acquirer first.

steady_gap_3pp_right_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 3 pp; priority lists the better acquirer first.

steady_gap_3pp_wrong_priority.description: 30 min, primary better by 3 pp; priority lists the worse acquirer first.

capacity_429_2_acquirers.description: 100 TPS; primary 503 from 100 s to 200 s; 1 backup(s) hold 15 concurrent requests each and answer 429 above capacity.

capacity_collapse_2_acquirers.description: 100 TPS; primary 503 from 100 s to 200 s; 1 backup(s) hold 15 concurrent requests each and collapse above it.

capacity_429_3_acquirers.description: 100 TPS; primary 503 from 100 s to 200 s; 2 backup(s) hold 15 concurrent requests each and answer 429 above capacity.

capacity_collapse_3_acquirers.description: 100 TPS; primary 503 from 100 s to 200 s; 2 backup(s) hold 15 concurrent requests each and collapse above it.

common_mode_issuer_incident.description: Issuer A (60% of payments) halves its approvals on every acquirer for 3 min; acquirers are unchanged, so the right response is not to move traffic.

segment_heterogeneity.description: 30 min; alpha approves issuer A 95% and issuer B 91.2%, beta the reverse; only a context-aware policy can route each issuer to its better acquirer.

inflight_concurrency.description: 200 TPS with 400 ms latency (about 80 in flight); primary answers 503 after 400 ms from 60 s to 120 s, so many decisions are made before any failure returns.

low_tps.description: 0.5 TPS for 1 h; primary 503 from minute 20 to minute 40.

high_tps.description: 500 TPS for 2 min; primary 503 from 40 s to 80 s.

bursty_tps.description: 2 TPS with 10 s bursts at 60 TPS every 40 s; primary 503 for 3 min.

soak_day_gap_0pp.description: 24 h at 1 TPS; primary 90%, secondary 90%; 30 min fast-fail outage, 30 min timeout outage, 2 h gray failure (primary at 80%).

soak_day_gap_1pp.description: 24 h at 1 TPS; primary 90%, secondary 89%; 30 min fast-fail outage, 30 min timeout outage, 2 h gray failure (primary at 80%).
